description: This Java class, SavingsStatusChecker, provides static utility methods to verify and check the status of savings accounts in the Fineract integration test suite. It includes methods for checking various account statuses such as approved, pending, active, rejected, withdrawn, closed, and sub-status checks like dormant, escheat, blocked, etc. It leverages external utilities for performing server requests and assertions, and uses logging for status verification.

classes.name: SavingsStatusChecker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to verify and check the statuses of savings accounts within integration tests.

methods.name: verifySavingsIsApproved
methods.description: Verifies that the savings account has the 'approved' status.

methods.name: verifySavingsIsPending
methods.description: Verifies that the savings account is pending approval.

methods.name: verifySavingsIsActive
methods.description: Verifies that the savings account is active.

methods.name: verifySavingsIsRejected
methods.description: Verifies that the savings application has been rejected.

methods.name: verifySavingsIsWithdrawn
methods.description: Verifies that the savings application has been withdrawn by the applicant.

methods.name: verifySavingsAccountIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies that the savings account is closed.

methods.name: verifySavingsAccountIsNotActive
methods.description: Verifies that the savings account is not active.

methods.name: getStatusOfSavings
methods.description: Fetches the current status of the savings account from the server.

methods.name: getSubStatusOfSavings
methods.description: Fetches the sub-status of the savings account from the server.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusInactive
methods.description: Verifies the savings account sub-status is 'inactive'.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusDormant
methods.description: Verifies the savings account sub-status is 'dormant'.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusEscheat
methods.description: Verifies the savings account sub-status is 'escheat'.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusNone
methods.description: Verifies the savings account sub-status is 'none'.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusblock
methods.description: Verifies the savings account is blocked.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusIsNone
methods.description: Verifies the savings account is not blocked for transactions.

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusIsDebitBlocked

methods.name: verifySavingsSubStatusIsCreditBlocked
